verdict.reasons: The main commercial package (white-and-blue upright cylindrical AFP drip-tape carton roll) is present, authentic, and properly integrated in the scene with the correct branding and sleeve captions. However, the installed irrigation laterals are coiled black, thick round hoses rather than the continuous thin flattened drip-tape lines expected for the tape20 product and article focus. This wrong installed line makes the observed product family mixed and prevents the image from functioning as a coherent agronomy illustration of the described drip-tape system. The installed evidence does not match the technical subject (flat tape vs. round hose), so it must be rejected under the mixed-family and technical-evidence-match conditions.

focused_physical_review.reason: There is no clear soil gap around the package footprint because a distinct, additional loose black coil of irrigation tape is located immediately to the right of the carton on the same ground plane. The required white-and-blue package itself is clean with no protruding straps or tape tails, and no irrigation line is observed touching, crossing, or emerging from its base.
